mechanism: Both drugs are renally cleared and topiramate may increase piperacillin/tazobactam levels in renal impairment; topiramate can cause metabolic acidosis which may potentiate antibiotic effects and increase seizure risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, adjust piperacillin/tazobactam dosing if eGFR <50 mL/min, and assess for metabolic acidosis during concurrent use.
